theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gv_vertical_field_first_variation
theorems.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid m)) (R : IMRep U n) (ζ : Euclid m → ℝ) (e : Euclid m), Differentiable ℝ ζ → R.firstVariation (fun x => ζ x • e) = ∫ x, fderiv ℝ ζ x ((approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection e) ∂R.measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
